name: ci-bottlenecks
description: Find performance problems in GitHub Actions pipelines

scripts.build: bun build src/action.ts --target=node --outfile dist/index.js && bun build src/cli.ts --target=node --outfile dist/cli.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const f='dist/cli.js'; const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'); if(!c.startsWith('#!'))fs.writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c); fs.chmodSync(f,0o755)"
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun test && bun run build

author: John Carmack
